rationale: The buyer is a specific, named professional role — Salesforce developers and ISV partners at agencies and SaaS companies — who already have a budget for tooling and whose time is billed at $100–200/hr, meaning a single debugging session costs more than a year of a $49/mo tool subscription. The pain (silent deploy success with runtime schema failures) is severe, reproducible, and costs real developer hours. The build is plausible: a Claude-powered CLI/webhook that runs post-deploy smoke tests against the runtime schema, detects mismatches, and surfaces a plain-language diagnosis — all doable with Claude + a simple form/Stripe + webhook integration. Operational autonomy is solid (run on demand, report async), but the responsiveness signal is completely untested (one StackExchange post), which keeps it at validate. Build gate for willingness_to_pay is marginally met (Salesforce devs do pay for tooling like Gearset, Copado, etc.); operational_autonomy and buildability_with_ai both clear their floors.
solution_plan: WHAT: A Salesforce post-deployment smoke-test micro-service — the operator pastes a deployment manifest or org credentials, Claude runs automated schema verification checks and returns a plain-language report of any runtime mismatches. BUILD: The factory sets up a Claude-powered webhook that accepts a Salesforce org URL + session token, queries the Metadata API and runtime EntityParticle API, compares them, and emails/Slacks a diff report; a Stripe payment link ($49–99/mo) and a short intake form are the only UI needed — no coding by the operator. SELL: Target Salesforce developer communities (Salesforce Stack Exchange, Trailblazer Community, developer-focused Slack groups like SF Dev/Ohana Slack, LinkedIn search for 'Salesforce developer agency'); Claude drafts outreach messages that go out only after operator approval. MAINTAIN: New orgs self-onboard via the form, Claude runs checks on a schedule or on webhook trigger, billing is automated via Stripe — the only recurring operator task is approving outreach batches and reviewing flagged anomaly reports. VALIDATE FIRST: Before building, run 10 cold outreach messages to Salesforce agency developers and confirm at least 2 express interest in a paid beta.
notes: All build_gates met at current scores (operational_autonomy=7, buildability_with_ai=7, buyer_clarity=7, willingness_to_pay=6). Stage is 'validate' because total=6.2 is below the 6.5 build threshold, and responsiveness_signal is completely untested. One confirmed paying beta customer would likely push this to build.
